# Circuit Diagram Generator

> AI circuit diagram generator that turns plain-English text prompts or photos of hand-drawn sketches into clean, editable, simulation-ready circuit schematics.

Circuit Diagram Generator (circuitdiagramgenerator.ai) is a web app for students, teachers, hobbyists, and engineers. Describe a circuit in natural language, or upload an image of a sketch or existing diagram, and the AI drafts a standards-correct schematic with real components and footprints. Edit manually or by chat, simulate before you build, and export to KiCad, Eagle, PDF, or SVG.

## Primary product

- Home: https://www.circuitdiagramgenerator.ai/
- AI circuit simulator: https://www.circuitdiagramgenerator.ai/simulator
- App (sign in / generate): https://app.circuitdiagramgenerator.ai/
- Pricing: https://www.circuitdiagramgenerator.ai/pricing
- Blog: https://www.circuitdiagramgenerator.ai/blog

## What it does

- AI circuit diagram generator from text — type a prompt like "555 timer LED blinker, 9V battery" and get a full schematic
- AI circuit diagram generator from image — upload a photo of a whiteboard or notebook sketch and get a redrawn, labeled schematic
- AI circuit simulator — describe a circuit and simulate it without drawing it first; see https://www.circuitdiagramgenerator.ai/simulator
- Circuit diagram generator with built-in simulation to verify behavior before ordering parts
- Real component library with accurate pinouts and footprints (not generic symbols only)
- Manual editing plus AI-assisted revisions without breaking reviewed work
- Engineering exports: KiCad, Eagle, PDF, SVG
